notes.title: RELEASE WINDOW TRAILER
notes.notes: [p]Today we are very happy to share another update on [b]ROUTINE[/b], along with a new trailer which we were lucky enough to debut this evening during Gamescom Opening Night Live.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="hH5ZYM3nCP0;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][p]That’s right, [b]ROUTINE[/b] will launch in late 2025 on Steam and Xbox platforms. It’s been a long ride, but we’re almost there. [/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for being patient with us. We are still busy working on the game but we're excited to share more from the world of ROUTINE with you again soon. [/p][p][/p][p]-Lunar Software[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update - October 30, 2022
notes.notes:
There have been a few inquiries about the safety and well-being of the Lunar base's Independent Computers. We recently obtained footage showing that they are still in operation and appear very functional.

[previewyoutube=XmBQyYgdesE;full][/previewyoutube]

[b][u]FAQ[/u][/b]

[b]• What engine are you using?[/b]
[list]
[*]
For the Re-reveal trailer we were still using Unreal Engine 4, but we have now made the switch to Unreal Engine 5.[/list]
[b]• Who is working on Routine?[/b]
[list]
[*]
It's the same core team of 4 people, however, thanks to our publisher Raw Fury, we have been able to get extra help on the Art and Writing side of things.[/list]
[b]• Will the game support 4:3 resolutions so we can enjoy it on our favourite CRT?[/b]
[list]
[*]
As huge fans of CRT's This is something we are already looking into but can't promise anything just yet.[/list]
[b]• Is the trailer pre-rendered?[/b]
[list]
[*]
Everything in the trailer was realtime and in-engine. All first person sequences were actual gameplay.[/list]

We hope you all have a spooky Halloween and found some great titles during the Steam Scream event!

[i]-Lunar Software[/i]
